answers.label: FACTS
answers.heading: A custom website, stated plainly.
answers.intro: CPWD is a web development studio in the Netherlands. We design and build bespoke websites and web apps, from brief to launch and hosting.

what.a: We build bespoke websites, web apps and the hosting around them. No templates. Design, development and launch sit in one engagement.

price.a: A one-page site starts at €{onePage}. A portfolio at €{portfolio}. A business site at €{business}. A webshop at €{webshop}. A web app at €{webapp}. Hosting with CPWD is €{hosting} per year. Extra pages and options sit on top. The planner gives a no-obligation indication. The quote after that is a fixed price.

time.a: A compact site is often live within a few weeks. A webshop or web app takes longer, depending on content and integrations.

where.a: From the Netherlands, in Dutch and English, for clients here and abroad. Contact runs through info{'@'}cpwd.nl.
